title: Speculative Error Variants
damaged_code:
```rust
enum DatabaseError {
    ConnectionFailed,
    QueryTimedOut,
    UnusedHypotheticalCrash, // never constructed or returned
}
```
pattern: Declaring error variants in custom `enum` types that are never constructed, thrown, or returned in any execution path.
why_bad: Forces downstream match statements to handle impossible error conditions with dead branches, increasing cognitive weight.
detection: Enum variants that are never used as values in any return or construction path.
counterexample: Public library APIs where external consumers might return those variants.
source: Fowler, *Refactoring*, Chapter 3 ("Speculative Generality"); Edwin Brady, *Type-driven Development with Idris* (2017).
